newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - June 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - June 9.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Agriculture Minister Lambert Kouassi Konan visits Bongouanou, says decline of former cocoa belt region to be revived by new crops, turnkey projects.
- President Henri Konan Bedie meets delegation sent by Sierra Leone coup leaders, Foreign Minister Amara Essy says Ivory Coast cannot support military coups.
- Cloth importers protest at new regulations requiring printed cloth to carry a label of origin.
